en.intro: Krishna carries on from the idea of mental renunciation by explaining what the supreme being actually creates.
en.notice: The key actor here is svabhava, nature. While the Lord creates no doer, no action, and no binding result, nature alone keeps moving forward on its own.
en.next: Krishna then explains that the all-pervading Lord takes neither wrongdoing nor good deeds, and that knowledge is covered by ignorance.
en.meaning: The supreme being creates neither doership nor actions nor the link between action and result for people. Nature alone keeps moving.

hi.intro: कृष्ण पिछले श्लोक में मन से त्याग की बात करते हैं, अब वे बताते हैं कि परमेश्वर वास्तव में क्या रचता है।
hi.meaning: परमेश्वर मनुष्योंके न कर्तापनकी, न कर्मोंकी और न कर्मफलके साथ संयोगकी रचना करते हैं किन्तु स्वभाव ही बरत रहा है ॥
hi.notice: यहाँ स्वभाव, यानी प्रकृति, ही वह है जो स्वयं चलती है। प्रभु अलग से कर्ता, कर्म या फल की रचना नहीं करते, प्रकृति ही अपने आप चलती रहती है।

en.intro: Krishna carries on from the idea of mental renunciation by explaining what the supreme being actually creates.
en.body: The supreme being creates neither doership nor actions nor the link between action and result for people. Nature alone keeps moving. The key actor here is svabhava, nature. While the Lord creates no doer, no action, and no binding result, nature alone keeps moving forward on its own. Krishna then explains that the all-pervading Lord takes neither wrongdoing nor good deeds, and that knowledge is covered by ignorance.

issues: borrowed: "ज्ञान से अज्ञान ढक जाता है" (The Hindi notice ('ज्ञान से अज्ञान ढक जाता है') presents the content of the NEXT verse (verse 15), which states that knowledge is covered by ignorance, as if it belongs to this verse (verse 14), which is about the Lord creating neither doership, actions, nor their link, and nature operating on its own.)
